scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic and applies to every nonzero measurable radial weight with all moments finite. Finite checker tests are illustrative, not an infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires entire functions and exterior domination at every point outside the comparison circle; does not treat disk-annulus Bergman domination, nonradial weights, or p != 2.
title: Sharp Korenblum radius for every radial entire-function \(L^2\) norm
